substantive_nonglyph.observed: Distinct table, sill and floor support contacts compare different plant sizes in a shared frontal domestic section.

style.assigned_relationship: Frontal stepped support-height comparison with invitation/body entry and lower identity seam.
style.observed_relationship: Implemented; broad table and lower sill organize ledger and lower identity, while a floor-grounded tall right tree gives full-height counterweight.
style.observed_limit: Painted botanical detail is softer and denser than the requested dry contour and restrained architectural planes.

exclusion_check.observation: Furniture and plants act as a continuous support comparison: table edge is the visit ledger boundary, lower sill edge begins identity, and tree extends through right architecture to floor. The text has substantial ivory clearance, but this is not only a small image attached to a huge title/date board; real support heights organize the seams.
exclusion_check.remaining_concern: Painterly wall shadows and lush upper foliage weaken the intended broad graphic-plane character.

hangul_anatomy_spacing.observation: Stable mature sans bodies, counters, ordinary word spaces and aligned baselines are visible in all text rows.

information_relationship.observation: Invitation to prose to slogan/market shares left start; table edge leads to date/hours/venue and nearby access/care/URL. Lower identity stays out of that route.

function_contact.observation: Pot bases/saucers touch tabletop, sill and floor; visible table legs reach the floor. No human action is depicted or required.

material_edge_finish.observation: Clean type, plausible pot rims and support edges; watercolor leafy shadow and dense leaf veins exceed restrained dry finish.

observations.location: Left table, center sill and right floor
observations.observation: Medium broad-leaf pot rests on its saucer on the high table; small trailing round-leaf plant touches the thick lower sill; tall woody tree pot touches the floor. Front table legs and window uprights give distinct domestic support heights.

observations.location: Upper left through first table ledge
observations.observation: Invitation is strongest, then three broad prose lines share a left start. The quieter slogan and market name lead downward to the table edge and nearby date/hours/venue baseline, followed by access/care and URL.

High table edge and lower sill form a descending section. Tall right tree occupies the full height; three plant scales and floor-grounded pot remain distinct. Lower identity aligns beneath the central sill seam.

Korean bodies have stable counters and consonant/vowel proportions; type remains flat and mature over painted surfaces. Numeric dates, time colons, ampersand and intact URL are readable. Two thin separators between date/hours/venue are rules rather than extra lettering.

Same-file revisit shows medium-height longer horizontal en-dash forms between ranges, paired colons in both times and a centered day middle dot. Raster shape observation cannot certify original Unicode code points.

observations.location: Furniture, wall, foliage and pot edges
observations.observation: Pot rims, saucers, table feet and floor contact are clearly drawn. Painted leaf veins, cast shadows and mottled pots dominate the image finish; clay-red is largely the narrow timber table and pottery instead of broad restrained architectural planes.

residuals.location: Whole image language, especially upper-right foliage and ivory wall
residuals.issue: Finish is detailed botanical watercolor with leafy shadows and fairly dense tree foliage, softer and more lush than the assigned dry-contour restrained architectural section.

residuals.location: Clay-red table and lower architectural section
residuals.issue: Clay-red reads mostly as a narrow timber edge and pots rather than a broad authored architectural plane; muted teal sill and floor are more substantial.

repair_decision.cause: Correct the observed painterly/lush image treatment and narrow clay-red architectural presence while preserving exact copy and functioning domestic ledge reading route.
